name: Erik Wingren
bio:
Erik brings 20+ years of experience designing and shipping digital products and services, giving him a rare ability to contribute meaningfully at every stage — from early research through final delivery.

With a degree in anthropology, and graduate studies in creative business management and organizational development, Erik started his career in Design Research, but has expanded his toolbox over the years to span the full width of User Experience Design.

Before founding Interactivism in 2012, Erik worked in and around the LA startup / technology scene with companies like Idealab, Iconmobile, Sony Design Center, Myspace, and Science where he designed the UX for the launches of Dollar Shave Club, Dog Vacay, and MeUndies.

As a consultant, Erik helps clients develop brand and product propositions that are informed and inspired by real people's needs, behaviors, and motivations.
